broken_chronicles.gui.settings.title: Writing Settings
broken_chronicles.gui.settings.writingEn: Lets players open the writing screen. Off by default: players can only read and collect. Requires OP.
broken_chronicles.gui.settings.authorExp: Shows "Export entry" in the writing screen to dump your text as a datapack entry JSON. Requires OP.
broken_chronicles.gui.settings.autoColle: Reading any readable item files it into the chronicle automatically. Requires OP.
broken_chronicles.gui.settings.showUnkno: Shows ??? for uncollected revealable entries in the collection. Requires OP.
broken_chronicles.gui.settings.showColle: Shows "collected x/y" at the top of the collection. Requires OP.
broken_chronicles.gui.settings.enableBui: The 24 built-in guide fragments (iron golem, wither, ...). Turning this off unregisters them, so their ??? rows disappear from the chronicle too. Meant for modpacks replacing the whole narrative with their own content. Requires OP.
broken_chronicles.gui.settings.allowSurv: Lets survival players change a Lost Inscription's look with block + sneak right-click. Requires OP.
broken_chronicles.gui.settings.pagePages: How many pages a fragment page may hold in the writing screen (1-8). Client side only.
How many pages an item inscription may hold in the writing screen (1-8). Client side only.
broken_chronicles.gui.settings.defaultTe: Background used when an entry names no texture. Click to cycle.
File name when exporting, a-z 0-9 _ - only. Leave blank to derive it from the title.
broken_chronicles.gui.settings.entry.ord: Sort order inside the chronicle; smaller comes first.
broken_chronicles.gui.settings.entry.rev: While not collected yet, the chronicle shows ??? so players know it exists.
broken_chronicles.gui.settings.entry.sta: Collected automatically on join (only meaningful when Revealable is on).
broken_chronicles.gui.settings.entry.wor: Collected by one player means collected for everyone; off means each player has their own.
broken_chronicles.gui.settings.entry.cre: Whether this content shows up as an item in the creative inventory.
broken_chronicles.gui.settings.entry.gro: Entries sharing a group are shown as one volume, e.g. your_mod:volume_1.
Display name of the group; leave blank to use the group id.
broken_chronicles.gui.settings.entry.loo: Library: which loot tables this entry is injected into, e.g. minecraft:chests/simple_dungeon.
Weight of this entry inside a loot table; higher means more likely (default 1).
broken_chronicles.gui.settings.entry.req: Story chain: this entry only appears after those entries are collected.
broken_chronicles.gui.settings.entry.ite: Which item carries this text, e.g. minecraft:apple.
broken_chronicles.gui.settings.entry.cha: Chance for naturally spawned items to carry this text, 0-100 (100 = always).
broken_chronicles.gui.settings.entry.hin: These fields are written into the exported entry JSON under config/broken_chronicles/entries/.
broken_chronicles.gui.writing.disabled_n: Writing is off: use Settings (top right) to enable it (requires OP)
broken_chronicles.gui.settings.entry.nar: The line under the title, stored as narrator in the entry JSON. Leave empty to hide it.
broken_chronicles.gui.settings.entry.des: Shown in the item tooltip and when hovering the entry in the chronicle. Leave empty to hide it.
broken_chronicles.gui.settings.entry.hin: A nudge for players who have not collected this yet; written as hint in the entry JSON.
broken_chronicles.gui.settings.entry.clu: The where-to-look line after the ???, e.g. Village chests, stronghold libraries.
Lets the player open this ??? and read how to get it plus any unmet requirements.
broken_chronicles.gui.settings.entry.pin: Sorts above every other entry in the chronicle, ignoring the order number.
broken_chronicles.gui.settings.entry.gat: When unmet, this content never spawns (loot tables, mob drops, world spawns). One per line, e.g. dimension:minecraft:the_end.
One per line: entry:ID / advancement:ID / dimension:ID / item:ID[:count] / scoreboard:objective:min
broken_chronicles.gui.settings.entry.con: When unmet the entry is never registered at all. One per line.
One per line: mod_loaded:modid / mod_not_loaded:modid / item_exists:ID / item_missing:ID
broken_chronicles.gui.settings.entry.onU: Datapack function run once when the player first collects this entry, e.g. your_mod:grant_reward.
Rolled once when the player first collects this entry; items that do not fit are dropped.
Command run as the player when they first collect this entry. Do not include the leading slash.
broken_chronicles.gui.settings.entry.aut: For books written as one block of text: split into pages automatically instead of counting characters yourself.
broken_chronicles.gui.settings.entry.ent: Only rolled when this mob dies, e.g. minecraft:zombie. Empty means no source filter.
broken_chronicles.gui.settings.entry.fis: Only rolled for fished-up items. Once any source is set, other sources stop carrying this text.
broken_chronicles.gui.settings.entry.tra: Only rolled for items obtained by trading with villagers.
broken_chronicles.gui.settings.entry.cra: Only rolled for items produced by crafting.
broken_chronicles.gui.list.row.tip: Click a line to edit it; clearing the text removes it.
broken_chronicles.gui.list.empty: Nothing here yet. Click Add a line to start.
broken_chronicles.gui.settings.allowCraf: The lost ink, lost inscription and transcribe recipes. Does not affect the Chronicle itself. Datapacks are reloaded automatically.
broken_chronicles.gui.settings.enforceSt: Entries stay hidden until their requires are collected. Turn off to ignore every requires, for debugging.
broken_chronicles.gui.settings.enforceGa: Content with unmet gates never spawns. Turn off to ignore every gates, for debugging.
broken_chronicles.gui.settings.syncEntry: Needed when the datapack only runs on the server. Only content is synced, never who collected what.
broken_chronicles.gui.settings.readingEn: Off: every reading entry point stops responding, silently. The chronicle itself still opens. Requires OP.
broken_chronicles.gui.settings.readOnRig: Right-click a Broken Fragment / Broken Tome to open it. Off: right-click does nothing. Requires OP.
broken_chronicles.gui.settings.readWhile: Press the read key with no screen open to read the item in your main / off hand. Requires OP.
broken_chronicles.gui.settings.readInCon: While the inventory, a chest or a backpack is open, hover an item and press the read key. Requires OP.
broken_chronicles.gui.settings.readTagge: Apples, swords and blocks carrying text (tag entries). Off: they keep their tooltip but cannot be opened. Requires OP.
broken_chronicles.gui.settings.readVanil: Reading and collecting written books and named paper. Off: the read key does nothing (a written book still opens with the vanilla screen, it is just not collected). Requires OP.
broken_chronicles.gui.settings.readInscr: Right-click a Lost Inscription with an empty hand to read it. Off: right-click does nothing, the text is kept. Requires OP.
broken_chronicles.gui.settings.collectio: Off: the chronicle cannot be opened and is gone from the creative tab and its recipe, and collecting stops as well (reading still opens, but nothing is recorded, no toast appears and the collection advancements are gone). Requires OP.
broken_chronicles.gui.settings.fragmentP: Off: fragments cannot be read or written, stop spawning as loot and leave the creative tab. Requires OP.
broken_chronicles.gui.settings.shardBook: Off: tomes cannot be read or written, stop spawning as loot and leave the creative tab. Requires OP.
broken_chronicles.gui.settings.fragmentI: Off: the ink does nothing on right-click, its recipe is removed and it leaves the creative tab. Requires OP.
broken_chronicles.gui.settings.lostInscr: Off: it cannot be placed or re-skinned, its recipe is removed and it leaves the creative tab. Requires OP.
broken_chronicles.gui.settings.transcrib: Off: the transcribe recipe is removed entirely (invisible to JEI and the recipe book). Requires OP.
